column1: # A/B LOOP MODE: the capped-iteration table (lane ab-loop-mode, 2026-11-24; AGENTS.md "Candidate evaluation": an A/B
# arm is decided on loop time per iteration). DATA, NOT CODE: tools/ab_loop.py reads it; nothing branches on a lane
# name anywhere else. One row per lane; a lane "*" row is its family's default for every lane not listed.
#   valid      yes: the cost of iteration i does not depend on i, so K iterations on the FULL dataset represent the fit;
#              no: the cell times the whole operation on the full dataset as before, and says why (the reason column).
#   cap_param  the estimator's PUBLIC parameter set to the cap, equally on both arms (read back from get_params).
#   cap        the default iteration cap K (the job's PC_AB_LOOP_CAP overrides it for every valid row).
#   pin        JSON object of further public parameters set on both arms so the executed count equals the cap
#              (early stopping and convergence tolerances off); {} when none.
#   unit       what one iteration is (what the estimator's fit_loop_ counts).
# Columns are tab separated; edit one lane per line (sub-lanes correct their family's rows).
